captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a realistic, highly detailed remote weapon station with a military-hardware aesthetic. It features a rigid, circular mounting base in dark grey, a cylindrical olive-green central housing with structural support brackets, and an articulated upper weapon cradle. The cradle houses a dark grey main gun barrel with a muzzle brake, flanked by an armored ammunition box on one side and optronic sensor housings on the other. The assembly is designed for natural articulation, allowing continuous horizontal panning of the housing and vertical elevation of the weapon cradle.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an articulated remote weapon station using CadQuery. The design should feature a dark grey circular mounting base, an olive-green cylindrical lower housing with structural brackets, a rotating armored upper turret, and an elevating gun cradle with a dark grey barrel and side-mounted ammunition box.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject consisting of three main parts linked by joints. The base is created using a wide, flat cylinder and a smaller vertical cylinder decorated with rectangular support gussets. The yaw housing (turret) is modeled as a cylindrical section with a flat top ring and is connected to the base via a continuous yaw joint. The weapon cradle (pitch part) is built from box primitives representing the armored gun housing, side-mounted ammunition box, and cylindrical barrel, and is attached to the turret using a revolute pitch joint.
